chain.label: Actuator forged from AA 2014-T6 aluminum susceptible to pitting corrosion
chain.trigger: an aluminum alloy tempered to maximum strength and hardness but susceptible to specific corrosion mechanisms, like pitting

chain.label: Retainer ring groove geometry imparts high stress concentration inside actuator housing
chain.trigger: the geometry of the housing where the retainer ring is located may impart a high stress concentration at the area of fatigue crack initiation

chain.label: Pitting corrosion along retainer ring groove corners on actuator interior
chain.trigger: pitting corrosion observed in the retainer ring groove served as areas of increased stress concentration, acting as sites for fatigue crack initiation

caused_by.evidence: The corrosion pitting is from normal chemical reactions of latent salt elements (Na, K, Cl, Ca, S, etc.) with the aluminum alloy.

chain.label: Internal cracks not detectable by the inspection techniques in use
chain.trigger: Since these cracks are entirely inside the actuator, they would be difficult to find with many standard techniques, like fluorescent penetration or visual examination.

chain.label: No life limit or overhaul interval established and service letters/AD did not address this failure mode
chain.trigger: Currently, no life limit has been defined or established for this actuator... none addressed the failure mode found in these accident investigations

chain.label: Fatigue cracks initiate at groove corner pits and propagate until the actuator housing fractures
chain.trigger: fatigue cracks initiated from pitting corrosion along the retainer ring groove corners on the interior of the actuator housing and propagated outward into the housing... the housing fractured

caused_by.evidence: The corners of the retainer ring groove already act as stress concentrators
the pits act as fatigue crack initiation sites
ultrasonic inspection or eddy current inspection should be able to detect such cracks before they propagate through the barrel of the actuator
an inspection and overhaul of the hydraulic actuator... at a regular interval would increase opportunities to detect any defects before they progress to failure

chain.label: Loss of hydraulic fluid and pressure through the fractured actuator
chain.trigger: which resulted in a loss of hydraulic fluid, leading to the actuator failing in service

caused_by.evidence: When the cracks grew large enough, the housing fractured, which resulted in a loss of hydraulic fluid

chain.label: Main landing gear fails to fully extend; gear system inoperative
chain.trigger: the main landing gear of a Cessna 210 or 210B airplane failed to fully extend

caused_by.evidence: loss of hydraulic pressure rendering the landing gear system inoperative

chain.label: Emergency gear-up landing or landing gear collapse at touchdown with airframe damage
chain.trigger: resulting in either an emergency gear-up landing or the landing gear collapsing at touchdown

caused_by.evidence: the main landing gear... failed to fully extend, resulting in either an emergency gear-up landing or the landing gear collapsing at touchdown
